title: Hosted API: Starter flow screenshot pack and code tiles for quickstart
creator: Aisha Nadeem
description: Purpose: produce a compact, reusable screenshot and code-tile pack for the Hosted API getting-started flow. Scope includes: model selection grid and details, request builder UI (simple presets + advanced toggles), three language code tiles (curl, Python SDK, Node SDK) including a streaming example and a function-calling example, and 1:1 retina PNG exports for docs and in-console quickstart. Outcomes: a set of labeled PNGs, a Figma file with annotated layers, and small copy strings for the docs that map to each screenshot. This ticket focuses on the visual assets and copy only; engineering hooks and telemetry will be handled in ENG follow-ups.
design_decisions: Use compact 3-up grid for model selector to fit desktop docs and console panels
Show token-estimate microcopy under model cards to reduce initial confusion about cost
Expose streaming toggle and function-calling checkbox in request builder advanced row rather than a modal
Use monospace, 14px for code tiles with copy buttons and short runnable examples only (link out to full examples)
